pages.title: Sand Block Color Puzzle
pages.creator: YIGOT
pages.description: Slide trays beneath sand of the same color in Sand Block Color Puzzle. Fill the trays and clear the board before time expires. Work through 600 layouts, using a magnet, hammer, or time freeze when an obstacle or an awkward shape slows you down.

pages.title: Pirates Story Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match pirate-themed pieces to travel the saga map in Pirates Story Match. Try the Ghost Regatta, collect doubloons for the Captain's Pass, or unlock Endless Voyage and see how many waves you can clear. Each mode gives you a different goal for your matches.

pages.title: Stack Bounce 3D
pages.creator: Wow Studio
pages.description: Smash through rings on a floating tower in Stack Bounce 3D. Guide the bouncing ball past red hazards and use fireballs or dynamite when they become available. Collect stars and unlock new ball skins as you work your way down.

pages.title: Domino Peak
pages.creator: Nextfly
pages.description: Choose from 13 domino variants in Domino Peak, including Block, Draw, All Fives, and Mexican Train. Practice against bots at three difficulty levels or join a table online. Create a private room with a code for friends, or team up for a two-on-two match.

pages.title: Candy Flow Factory
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Link matching candy machines with tubes in Candy Flow Factory. Plan routes that cover every playable tile without crossing or overlapping. There are 90 puzzles to work through, and you can take your time or use a hint when a connection leaves you stuck.

pages.title: Zen Solitaire
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build four suit piles in Zen Solitaire. Move cards between the columns to reveal face-down cards and look for the next rank you can send to a foundation. Take time to compare possible moves before committing to a sequence.

pages.title: Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Dig beneath a backyard to look for treasure in Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator. Follow the hole deeper into the earth and look for gemstones and metals among the material you uncover. See what you can bring up as you expand the dig.

pages.title: Arrow Shift Logic Tree
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Plan a route through the arrows in Arrow Shift Logic Tree. Follow the direction rules when you slide a piece and check where the move will leave you. Work out a sequence that opens the path without trapping you.

pages.title: My Arcade Center 2
pages.creator: GamesMrkt
pages.description: Build an arcade business in My Arcade Center 2. Earn money during the day and put it toward machines, staff, or a better layout at night. Expand across seven maps, switch between centers, and complete daily missions to help the business grow.

pages.title: Fruit Sort Logic
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Group matching juices on shelves in Fruit Sort Logic. Move them around to make sets of three and free up space for other drinks. Check which shelf has room before you move a juice, and clear every shelf to finish the level.

pages.title: Luxury Highway Cars
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Drive six luxury cars on three highways in Luxury Highway Cars. Look for gaps in traffic and use replenishing nitro to pass slower vehicles. Try three driving modes, then customize and upgrade your cars for another run.

pages.title: Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat!
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Guide a snake toward apples in Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat! Each apple makes the snake one segment longer. Plan which apples to eat and how to approach the portal once the snake is long enough to reach it.

pages.title: Marble Bubble Legend
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Drag a marble marked with an arrow to guide its chain into the slots in Marble Bubble Legend. Groups of three matching colors clear from the four spaces. Check which colors the chain will bring in next so you don't fill the slots before you can make a match.

pages.title: Knife Madness
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Throw knives at a spinning wheel in Knife Madness. Watch where the blades are already lodged and aim for an open part of the wheel. The wheel speeds up, so adjust your timing as you take on bosses and unlock more knife skins.

pages.title: Traitor Beaver!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Work at a nuclear power plant with other beavers in Traitor Beaver! One player is secretly working against the crew. As the traitor, disrupt tasks and eliminate the other players without giving yourself away. As a crew member, pay attention to what happens while the work is underway.

pages.title: Brainrot Hook Swing
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Swing between anchor points with a grappling hook in Brainrot Hook Swing. Use the momentum from each swing to clear obstacles and reach the next point. Time when you let go so you can carry enough speed to reach the finish.

pages.title: Gemstone Glam
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Dress two princesses in Gemstone Glam. Build outfits around the colors and sparkle of diamonds, rubies, emeralds, or amethysts. Pair each dress with a hairstyle and accessories that suit the gem you chose.

pages.title: Robby: Bomberman
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Plant bombs to clear crates and ghosts in Robby: Bomberman. Look for coins, bonuses, and a magical mushroom that can help in the maze. Ghosts can return while crates are still standing, so clear both to open the exit.

pages.title: Chicken Wild Run
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Tap to switch the chicken's direction in Chicken Wild Run. Collect coins and watch your stamina as you head for the goal. A kiss makes the chicken briefly invincible, and collecting ten bottles temporarily turns the coins along the road into diamonds.

pages.title: My Dinosaur Land
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Collect dinosaurs and put them in enclosures in My Dinosaur Land. Bring dinosaurs to the checkout to sell them, then put the money toward improving the farm. Keep tending to the creatures while you build up the operation.

pages.title: Hexa Tile Master
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Place stacks of hexagonal tiles on the board in Hexa Tile Master. Bring matching colors together so they merge, then clear groups of at least ten. Look at where a stack will leave room for the next one, and finish clearing the board before time expires.

pages.title: GunFu Stickman 2
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Fire two pistols at approaching enemies in GunFu Stickman 2. React as targets appear and pick them off before the onslaught gets ahead of you. Unlock more weapons and outfits and try a different setup when you go back for another run.

pages.title: Gym Muscle Merge Tycoon
pages.creator: PixelBro
pages.description: Combine fighters to make stronger ones in Gym Muscle Merge Tycoon. Improve their stats and build a team that can earn more as it grows. Put that team into fighting tournaments to compete for rewards.

pages.title: Brother!Follow Me! - Merge Men
pages.creator: CrazyFire
pages.description: Pick up allies along a 3D obstacle course in Brother!Follow Me! - Merge Men. Steer around hazards and gather more brothers before you reach the boss. Try to bring as large a group as you can into the fight at the end of each level.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Butterfly
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Clear bubbles to release butterflies in Bubble Shooter Butterfly. Aim for groups of the same color and look for shots that open up a path to the trapped butterflies. Work through 300 levels across daytime and nighttime settings.

pages.title: Super Long Nose Dog
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stretch a borzoi's nose to solve puzzles in Super Long Nose Dog. Guide it toward the target and work out how to reach the enemies in each scene. Look at where the nose can go before extending it through the layout.

pages.title: Noob & Pro Skateboarding
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Guide two skateboarders with the same input in Noob & Pro Skateboarding. Keep track of both paths and rotate when an obstacle blocks Pro's lane. Make each move with both riders in mind so they can finish the level together.

pages.title: Roller Ball X : Bounce Ball
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Roll and jump through a factory in Roller Ball X : Bounce Ball. Use the arrow keys to guide the red ball, collect stars, and jump on enemies from above. Avoid laser beams and keep going toward the goal before the minions can turn the planet square.

pages.title: Helix Jump
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Rotate the tower in Helix Jump to line up gaps beneath the bouncing ball. Let it drop through the openings and check where it will land on the next platform. Keep it away from the forbidden sections on the way down.

pages.title: Football 3D
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Take free kicks against friends or play through a career in Football 3D. Visit different stadiums and take on soccer challenges to earn medals. Unlock items to change how your striker and goalkeeper look before the next match.

pages.title: Super Lule vs Zombies
pages.creator: rungames.org
pages.description: Help Lule clear 18 stages in Super Lule vs Zombies. Aim fireballs at the zombies threatening Princess Lili's land. You get seven shots per level, so make them count or you'll have to start the stage again.

pages.title: Jet Boat Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race a speedboat or explore the course in Jet Boat Racing. Use ramps to launch across the water and keep control on the narrow sections. Play either mode alone or with a second player, and finish races in first place to unlock boats.

pages.title: Owl and Rabbit Fashion
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Create looks for an owl and a rabbit in Owl and Rabbit Fashion. Try different style choices and see how they change each animal's appearance. Give the two characters their own looks as you work through the available options.

pages.title: Two impostor Squid Challenge
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Play two challenges with a friend in Two impostor Squid Challenge. Time your movement in Red Light, Green Light, then try to pull your opponent's side over in tug of war. The two events call for different timing.

pages.title: Collect Rings
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Watch a white ball bounce across the grid in Collect Rings. After it crosses a square five times, that square turns into a ball. Click the new ball and then the ring it produces. Collect rings before the white ball collides with a red one.

pages.title: Spot 5 Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find five small changes between two pictures in Spot 5 Differences. Compare the same area of each image and mark any detail that differs. Keep working through the pairs as the changes get harder to spot.

pages.title: Big Wheels Monster Truck
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Drive a truck with oversized tires in Big Wheels Monster Truck. Crush the cars on the route and keep the truck moving over the wreckage. Watch how the wheels climb each obstacle as you work toward the finish.

pages.title: Kingdom of Ninja
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a ninja through traps and past monsters in Kingdom of Ninja. Check the path ahead before moving into reach of an enemy. Work through ten sections as you try to make it safely to the kingdom.

pages.title: Endless Tree
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Guide a bird up a tree in Endless Tree. Tap to shift left or right before a branch blocks the way, and collect coins to build your score. Keep looking up the trunk so you can switch sides in time.

pages.title: Zombie Survival
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Get a little zombie onto the safe platform in Zombie Survival. Click or tap objects to remove them, then watch where the zombie falls and bounces. Think through the order before clearing a support so the zombie doesn't go off the screen.

pages.title: Extreme Offroad Cars 3: Cargo
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Deliver cargo over difficult ground in Extreme Offroad Cars 3: Cargo. Watch the route as you drive and adjust your speed before rough sections. Reach the destination with the load still on board to complete the delivery.

pages.title: Special Strike Zombies
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Fight waves of zombies and mercenaries as a special forces soldier in Special Strike Zombies. Choose a weapon that suits the enemies coming at you and keep firing as the next group closes in. Survive each wave to complete the level.

pages.title: Among Them Jumper
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Jump from platform to platform in Among Them Jumper. Tap to climb and keep clear of enemies and spikes. Use a bomb to clear enemies from the screen, and look for shields or jump boosts as you try to beat your score.

pages.title: Mine Sweeper
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Clear a field of hidden mines in Mine Sweeper. Use the numbers on revealed squares to work out where the neighboring mines must be. Mark the dangerous squares and open the safe ones, because setting off a mine ends the game.

pages.title: Sushi Feast!
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Shoot sushi into groups of matching food in Sushi Feast! Look for the next opening as the pieces travel along the track. Clear the level's targets to unlock more stages and new looks.

pages.title: Monster Catcher
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Release a catcher to grab monsters in Monster Catcher. Choose a target that has an identical copy elsewhere on the screen, since the catcher needs a matching pair to work. Reach the capture goal before you lose all three lives and finish quickly for bonus points.

pages.title: Goblin Fight Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Line up three or more pieces of the same color in Goblin Fight Match 3. Clear groups and look for new matches as the board changes. Keep an eye on the gauge on the left, because the game ends if it drops too low.

pages.title: Wizard Vs Orcs
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Fire magic shots at invading orcs in Wizard Vs Orcs. Look at where the enemies are positioned before you tap to fire. Work through 36 levels and stop the orcs threatening the kingdom.

pages.title: Super Escape Masters
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Dig a route from prison to the escape truck in Super Escape Masters. Get around spikes, explosives, water, and guards while looking for friends you can rescue. Collect keys and gold as you work through 24 underground routes.

pages.title: Tower Run Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Jump onto another runner's shoulders at the marked spots in Tower Run Online. Build a taller stack so you can clear walls and earn more coins at the finish. Spend the coins on new characters as you improve your timing.

pages.title: Wild Hunt: Jungle Sniper Shooting
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Track wild animals and line up shots in Wild Hunt: Jungle Sniper Shooting. Pay attention to the animal's position as you aim through the scope. Look for a clear shot as you move through the hunting locations.

pages.title: Julio Police Cars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive a police car across stunt maps in Julio Police Cars. Pick from ten vehicles, including a police limousine, and try the ramps scattered across four maps. Build speed for a jump or practice drifting when you have room to turn.

pages.title: farting flippy King
pages.creator: GameZing
pages.description: Keep an alien flying in farting flippy King. Use bursts of gas to lift it and watch for the blades in its way. Time the bursts to hold the right height and get through each opening.

pages.title: Snake Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Collect apples, grapes, and oranges to grow longer in Snake Challenge. Watch the space around your tail so you can turn without hitting yourself or a wall. Try doubling the speed when you want less time to decide where to go next.

pages.title: Virtual Piano
pages.creator: Almanac Group
pages.description: Play a melody on the keys in Virtual Piano. Choose the control method that suits you and try different notes in sequence. Practice a tune you know or put together a melody of your own.

pages.title: the kidnapped ghost
pages.creator: Pandemia Games
pages.description: Watch the pumpkins in the kidnapped ghost and help the little ghost hide from the witches. When it's the black witch's turn, point to a pumpkin that doesn't contain the ghost. Keep track of the hiding place so you can lead her away from it.

pages.title: Penguin Cafe
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Help Berta serve customers in Penguin Cafe. Take orders and bring food to the tables as penguins and their neighbors visit the café. Keep track of who is waiting while you run the restaurant on a floating iceberg.

pages.title: Turbo cannon
pages.creator: Nela´s games
pages.description: Aim a jet of liquid to keep a man on a slide in Turbo cannon. Adjust the direction of the spray and watch how his position changes. Try to keep him on the slide as he loses the excess liquid.

pages.title: Animal Daycare Games
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a pet and look after it in Animal Daycare Games. Use the mouse to help with care activities such as bathing, feeding, or treating injuries. Pick another activity to work with different tools and see what the animals need.

pages.title: Animals Memory Game
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Turn over cards to find pairs of animals in Animals Memory Game. Remember where each picture appeared so you can match it when you find the other copy. Clear the cards across all eight levels.

pages.title: Math Matador
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Answer as many equations as you can before time runs out in Math Matador. Work out each result and enter your answer before moving on to the next problem. Try to improve your total of correct answers on another round.

pages.title: Catching Flight
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fly past skyscrapers and dodge incoming missiles in Catching Flight. Collect money to buy another aircraft and look for green coins to power the shield. Use the shield to destroy missiles when you need protection.

pages.title: EG Emoji Pong
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Move the paddle to return the ball and hit emojis in EG Emoji Pong. Watch the angle after each bounce and get into position before the ball reaches the ground. The speed increases, giving you less time to make each return.

pages.title: Sudoku Challenge
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Fill empty squares with the missing numbers in Sudoku Challenge. Check the numbers already in each row, column, and box before choosing what fits. Try different modes and grid sizes, or open the tutorial if you want to learn the rules.

pages.title: Motorbike Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pick from six bikes in Motorbike Racing and take one out on the track. Try four game modes and four courses as you get used to the bike's handling. Switch models or tracks when you want a different race.

pages.title: Sand Drawing
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Draw with the mouse in Sand Drawing. Pick a type of sand and trace lines across its surface to create a picture. Switch textures or try a new design to see how the marks look on different backgrounds.

pages.title: Pump Up the Birds
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Inflate your birds to take over rivals in Pump Up the Birds. The larger bird converts the smaller one when they collide. Time when you pump, because hitting another bird while yours is inhaling makes it lose air.

pages.title: American Football Challenge
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Move the receiver's gloves to catch passes in American Football Challenge. Follow the ball with the mouse or your finger as it comes toward you. Get the gloves into its path and see how many throws you can catch.

pages.title: Mini Time Racer
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Race the clock in Mini Time Racer. Drive with the arrow keys or WASD, or use the on-screen buttons on mobile. Steer through each turn and try to improve your time on another run.

pages.title: Fruit Matching Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Line up matching fruit in Fruit Matching Game and score as much as you can in one minute. Match four to make a bomb or five to clear one fruit type from the grid. Look for hourglasses when you need extra seconds.

pages.title: Mahjong Linker : Kyodai Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Link matching tiles in Mahjong Linker : Kyodai Game. Look for a route between them that uses no more than three straight segments. Clear the whole board before time runs out, and use the spaces left by earlier pairs to reach new ones.

pages.title: Death Chase
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description: Race over rough tracks and big jumps in Death Chase. Pull off stunts to build nitro and use rockets when rivals get in your way. Collect coins and stars during races, then use your progress to customize and upgrade the vehicle.

pages.title: Soccer Skills Runner
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Carry the ball past defenders in Soccer Skills Runner. Swerve, jump, or duck depending on what's in front of you and keep running until you're tackled. Pick up power-ups and upgrade your player before trying to go farther.

pages.title: Easy Joe World
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help a rabbit get back to his friends in Easy Joe World. Look around each scene for something you can use to clear a trap or solve a puzzle. Get Joe through one obstacle at a time to continue his journey.

pages.title: Punk Princess Garderobe
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Give a princess a punk makeover in Punk Princess Garderobe. Try new eyeshadow colors and add mascara, then choose clothes that suit the look. Experiment with different makeup and outfit combinations to give her a style of her own.

pages.title: Sleeping Beauty N' Briar Beauty
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style a mother and daughter in Sleeping Beauty N' Briar Beauty. Choose a light outfit for Sleeping Beauty, then move on to Briar and build a look for her. Try different pieces to give both characters something to wear for their day out.

pages.title: Beauty and the Beast
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help the Beast impress Belle in Beauty and the Beast. Search the garden for a flower and pick from the roses and tulips you find. Choose a pet and help with the other tasks as he tries to win her heart and break the spell.

pages.title: Cooking Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate doughnuts for two princesses in Cooking Contest. Try chocolate, candies, and sweet syrups as you put together a design for each entry. See how the finished doughnuts fare in the competition.

pages.title: Barbie Monster High Halloween
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Make a Monster High-inspired costume in Barbie Monster High Halloween. Try hairstyles, outfits, and accessories from Barbie's collection, then put together a look for the themed party. Mix pieces from different styles until you're happy with the costume.

pages.title: White Princess Romantic Date
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Get Snow White ready for an anniversary in White Princess Romantic Date. Choose an outfit for her evening with Prince Charming as she looks back on their adventures with the seven dwarfs. Try different pieces before settling on a look for the date.
